objective.text: Inspect recipients and domain data in a mail assertion callback.

difficulty.rationale: Verify both destination and business context instead of only a class or count.

runtime.sapi: Isolated CLI Laravel harness unless another context is explicitly stated
runtime.errorPolicy: E_ALL; UTC; no external services or application data

stem: A receipt test must verify invoice 7 is sent to owner@example.test. The mailable exposes invoiceId. Which assertion checks both requirements?

options.rationale: A count alone does not establish either recipient or invoice identity.
options.misconception: A count alone does not establish either recipient or invoice identity.

options.rationale: This checks the recipient but can pass for the wrong invoice.
options.misconception: This checks the recipient but can pass for the wrong invoice.

options.rationale: The predicate examines the actual recorded mailable recipient and its domain data.
This checks the invoice but can pass for mail sent to the wrong recipient.
